# Srota — Business apps for a paperless Nepal
# https://srotaapps.com

Srota is a Nepali SaaS platform offering two business management applications:
Srota RMS (Restaurant Management System) and Srota IMS (Inventory Management
System). Both are built specifically for Nepal and are compliant with Nepal's
Electronic Billing Procedure 2082 (IRD CBMS integration).

## Pages

- Homepage: https://srotaapps.com/

## Key facts

- Founded: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Target market: Nepali restaurants, retail shops, and multi-branch businesses
- Compliance: Nepal IRD VAT, Electronic Billing Procedure 2082, CBMS-integrated
- Languages supported: English (Nepali UI in progress)
- Trial: 30-day free trial, no credit card required
- Contact: srotaapps@gmail.com
